irado.definitionKo: 불확실한 사실에 대한 말하는 이의 의심이나 의문을 나타내는 조사.
irado.englishDescription: A postpositional particle that indicates the speaker's doubt or question about an unclear fact.

ireoke.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '이러하게' (a conjugated form of '이러하다' (be like this)).

jangajji.definitionKo: 오이, 무, 마늘 등의 채소를 간장이나 소금물에 담가 놓거나 된장, 고추장 속에 넣었다가 양념해서 오래 두고 먹는 음식.
jangajji.englishDescription: Pickled vegetables, a side dish made by pickling vegetables like cucumbers radishes, garlic, etc. in soy sauce, salt water, doenjang, soybean paste, or gochujang, red chili paste; it is preserved for a long period of time, and served seasoned with a variety of spices and sesame oil.

japgokbap.definitionKo: 쌀에 잡곡을 섞어서 짓거나 잡곡만으로 지은 밥.
japgokbap.englishDescription: Rice cooked by boiling white rice mixed with other cereals or boiling just a variety of cereals.

jeoreogo.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '저리하고' (a conjugated form of '저리하다' (do that)).

latitude.definitionKo: 지구 위의 위치를 가로로 나타내는 것.
latitude.englishDescription: An imaginary, horizontal line used to designate a location on earth.

lever.definitionKo: 무거운 물건을 움직이는 데에 사용하는 막대기.
lever.englishDescription: A long stick used to move a heavy object.

lever.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 어떤 목적을 이룰 수 있게 하는 수단이나 힘.
lever.englishDescription: (figurative) A method or force that enables one to achieve a purpose.

libya.definitionKo: 아프리카 대륙의 북부 해안에 있는 나라. 세계적인 산유국이며 국토 대부분이 사막으로 주로 양과 염소를 유목한다. 공용어는 아랍어이고 수도는 트리폴리이다.
libya.englishDescription: A country located on the northern coast of Africa; it is a major oil producer with most of its land desert; its rural inhabitants usually herd sheep and goats; its official language is Arabic and its capital is Tripoli.

linguistics.englishDescription: An academic field that studies languages.
An academic field that studies languages.

malaysia.definitionKo: 동남아시아 말레이반도의 남쪽과 보르네오섬 일부에 걸쳐 있는 나라. 주요 생산물로는 고무, 석유, 목재 등이 있다. 공용어는 말레이어이고 수도는 쿠알라룸푸르이다.
malaysia.englishDescription: A country between the south of the Malay peninsula and Borneo of Southeast Asia; its staple goods are rubber, oil, lumber, etc.; the official language is Malay and the capital in Kuala Lumpur.

manner.definitionKo: 오랜 시간을 거쳐 오면서 자연스럽게 정해진 공통의 방식.
manner.englishDescription: A common manner established naturally through a long time.

manner.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 해 나가기 위한 수단이나 방식.
manner.englishDescription: A method or way of doing something.

manner.definitionKo: 말이나 글, 행동 등에서 버릇처럼 굳어지거나 특별하게 나타나는 방식.
manner.englishDescription: A method which repeats habitually or is noticeable especially in someone's speech, writing, behavior, etc.

mantis.definitionKo: 몸통이 가늘고 길며 머리는 삼각형이고, 긴 앞다리가 낫처럼 구부러지는 곤충.
mantis.englishDescription: An insect with a slender body, triangular head, and long front legs that are bent like sickles.

marina.definitionKo: 배를 대고 매어 놓는 곳이나 비행기를 두는 곳.
marina.englishDescription: A place where a boat is docked or a plane is kept.

marujang.definitionKo: 마루의 바닥에 깔아 놓은 반듯하고 평평한 나무.
marujang.englishDescription: floorboard: A flat, clear-cut board laid on the floor.

marvel.definitionKo: 놀랍고 신기하게 여김. 또는 그럴 만한 일.
marvel.englishDescription: Being amazed by something, or something to be amazed about.

massager.englishDescription: A person whose job it is to give clients massages.

massager.definitionKo: 안마를 할 수 있도록 만든 기계나 도구.
massager.englishDescription: A machine or implement giving a massage.

masturbation.definitionKo: (속된 말로) 자기 성기를 자극하여 성적 쾌감을 얻는 행위.
masturbation.englishDescription: (slang) The act of getting sexual pleasure by stimulating one's own genitals.

masturbation.englishDescription: The act of feeling sexual pleasure by stimulating one's genitals by oneself.

materialize.definitionKo: 어떤 현상이나 사건이 실제로 드러나다. 또는 실제로 드러나게 하다.

maturely.definitionKo: 나이는 어리지만 행동이나 생각이 어른 같은 데가 있게.

mb.englishDescription: A bound noun that serves as a unit of data quantity.

measles.definitionKo: 감기와 비슷한 증상으로 시작하여 입안에 흰 반점이 생기고 나중에는 온몸에 좁쌀 같은 붉은 발진이 돋는 급성 전염병.
measles.englishDescription: An acute infectious disease whose initial symptoms are similar to those of a cold and which causes the victim to develop white spots in the mouth and tiny red rashes throughout the body.

measurement.definitionKo: 장치를 써서 시간, 크기, 길이, 양 등을 헤아려 수치로 나타냄.
measurement.englishDescription: Deciding and expressing the time, size, length, quantity, etc., using equipment.

measurement.definitionKo: 길이, 부피, 무게 등을 재서 사물의 양을 헤아림.
measurement.englishDescription: An act of calculating the amount of something by measuring its length, volume, weight, etc.

measurement.definitionKo: 기기를 사용하여 물건의 높이, 깊이, 넓이, 방향 등을 잼.
measurement.englishDescription: An act of taking the height, depth, width, direction, etc., of an object, by using a device.

measurement.definitionKo: 지표의 각 지점의 위치와 그 지점들 간의 거리를 구하고 지형의 높낮이나 면적 등을 재는 일.
measurement.englishDescription: An act of calculating the location of each point and the distance between points, and measuring the height or area of a landform, on a map.

measurement.englishDescription: An act of taking the different quantity of something in the same kind, by comparing it with a standard unit.

measurement.definitionKo: 옷, 신발, 몸의 일부분 등의 길이를 잰 값.
measurement.englishDescription: The value obtained by measuring the lengths of a piece of clothing, a shoe, or a part of one's body, etc.

mileage.definitionKo: 자동차가 일정한 양의 연료를 써서 움직이는 거리.
mileage.englishDescription: The distance that a car travels on a certain amount of fuel.

minjeogori.definitionKo: 깃, 끝동, 고름 등 어떤 부분에도 다른 색의 옷감을 대지 않은 저고리.

mink.definitionKo: 족제비와 비슷하게 생겼으며 털가죽을 고급 외투용으로 쓰는 갈색 동물.
mink.englishDescription: An animal resembling the weasel, whose brown fur is used for high-priced outerwear.

misspelling.definitionKo: 잘못 적음. 또는 그렇게 적은 것.

moral.englishDescription: Being helpful or instructive to a behavior.

moral.definitionKo: 도덕에 관한. 또는 도덕 규범에 맞는.

moral.definitionKo: 사람으로서 마땅히 지켜야 할 바람직한 행동 기준에 관련되거나 이를 따르는.
moral.englishDescription: Being associated with the code of conduct that one is supposed to follow as a human being, or observing it.

muhammad.definitionKo: 이슬람교의 창시자(?570~632). 히라산에서 알라 신의 계시를 받아 알라에 대한 숭배를 가르치기 시작했으며 아라비아 전역에 정치적, 역사적으로 큰 영향을 끼쳤다.

myopia.definitionKo: 가까운 곳에 있는 것은 잘 보나 먼 곳에 있는 것은 선명하게 보지 못하는 눈.
myopia.englishDescription: Eyes which can see objects which are close but not those which are far.

nagging.definitionKo: 같은 말을 계속 하면서 졸라 댐.
nagging.englishDescription: The act of pestering to get something by saying certain words repeatedly.

nagging.definitionKo: 옳고 그른 것을 따지며 남을 못살게 굴거나 괴롭히는 일.

Pressing someone very urgently and harshly.

narrative.englishDescription: Writing down the facts as they are.

nimbly.englishDescription: In an agile and quick manner.
In the manner of acting very swiftly.

nimbly.englishDescription: In the manner of doing a series of acts very quickly, randomly.
In such a manner that the body or mind is light and refreshed.

nimbly.definitionKo: 갑자기 빠르게 뛰거나 몸을 움직이는 모양.
nimbly.englishDescription: In the manner of running fast or moving one's body suddenly.

non-conform.definitionKo: 규범이나 기준, 이치 등에 맞지 않고 어긋나다.
non-conform.englishDescription: To not conform to and to be different from the norms, standard, principle, etc.

null.englishDescription: A state of being void or null.

obstruction.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 하는 데 거리끼거나 얽매임.
obstruction.englishDescription: To be hindered or entangled in doing something.

obstruction.definitionKo: 일이 잘 되지 않고 막히는 상태.
obstruction.englishDescription: A state in which things do not work out smoothly due to obstacles.

obstruction.definitionKo: 다른 것과의 관계나 접촉을 막거나 끊음.
obstruction.englishDescription: An act of blocking or cutting off any relationship or contact with other people or things.
An act of interrupting another's affair.

operation.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 법, 제도 등을 실제로 행함.
operation.englishDescription: An act of actually executing or enforcing a certain plan, law, system, etc.

operation.definitionKo: 정해진 길을 따라 자동차나 열차 등이 다님.
operation.englishDescription: A car or train, etc., running along a preset route.

operation.definitionKo: 기계 등이 움직여 일함. 또는 기계 등을 움직여 일하게 함.
operation.englishDescription: A state in which a machine, etc. runs, or the act of getting a machine, etc. to run.

operation.definitionKo: 조직 등이 구성되어 일함. 또는 조직 등을 구성하여 일하게 함.
operation.englishDescription: A state in which an organization, etc. is formed and run, or the act of forming and running an organization, etc.

operation.definitionKo: 병을 고치기 위하여 몸의 한 부분을 째고 자르거나 붙이고 꿰매는 일.
operation.englishDescription: An act of slitting, cutting, attaching, and stitching a body part or organ in order to treat an illness.
Calculation according to a certain rule in mathematics.

operation.definitionKo: 조직이나 기구, 사업체 등을 관리하고 이끌어 나감.
operation.englishDescription: An act of managing and leading an organization, group, business entity, etc.
The act of using or making something move.
The act of moving and handling a machine or car.

operation.definitionKo: 기계 등이 움직여 일함. 또는 기계 등을 움직여 일하게 함.
operation.englishDescription: The act of a machine, etc., working; the act of making a machine, etc., work.
The act of working by operating a machine, etc.

operation.definitionKo: 기계나 장치 같은 것을 일정한 방식에 따라 다루어 움직이게 함.
operation.englishDescription: The act of making a machine, device, etc., move by handling it in a certain way.

operation.definitionKo: 비행기나 배 같은 기계를 다루어 움직이게 함.
operation.englishDescription: The act of handling a machine such as an airplane, ship, etc., to make it move.

operation.definitionKo: 군사적 목적을 이루기 위해 행하는 전투, 수색, 행군, 보급 등에 필요한 방법을 찾거나 조치를 함. 또는 그 방법이나 조치.
operation.englishDescription: The act of finding or devising methods or measures for battles, searches, marches, or supplies, etc., to conduct military purposes. Or such methods or measures.
An act of navigating a ship or plane along a certain route.

or.englishDescription: If not; or if it is not.

overflowingly.definitionKo: 액체가 가득 차서 자꾸 넘칠 듯 말 듯 하는 모양.
overflowingly.englishDescription: A word describing the state of liquid being about to overflow a container.
In the state of a place being full of a certain atmosphere.

overflowingly.definitionKo: 적은 양의 액체가 조금씩 넘쳐흐르는 모양.
overflowingly.englishDescription: In the manner of a small amount of liquid brimming over little by little.

overflowingly.definitionKo: 생기 있고 활발한 기운이나 감정이 가득 찬 모양.
overflowingly.englishDescription: In the manner of a fresh, vigorous energy or emotion brimming over.

overflowingly.definitionKo: 생기 있고 활발한 기운이나 감정이 가득 찬 모양.

pair.englishDescription: A state in which two things or persons become one body.

pair.englishDescription: Either one or both of two things that form a pair or set.

pair.definitionKo: 화투에서, 같은 짝 두 장으로 이루어진 패.

pair.englishDescription: To pair or cause to pair persons of mutual feelings.

pair.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 하기 위해 두 사람이 짝을 이루는 것. 또는 그 두 사람.
pair.englishDescription: An act of two persons pairing up to do a certain thing, or such two persons.

pair.definitionKo: 신발, 양말, 장갑 등 짝이 되는 두 개를 한 벌로 세는 단위.
pair.englishDescription: A bound noun serving as a unit to count two pieces of something such as shoes, socks, gloves, etc.

paperback.definitionKo: 책을 널리 보급하기 위해 만든, 값이 싸고 크기가 작은 책.
paperback.englishDescription: A small, cheap book designed to make the book read widely.

paperback.definitionKo: 책을 널리 보급하기 위해 가지고 다니기 편하도록 작은 크기로 만든 책.
paperback.englishDescription: A book for wide distribution made small enough to carry around conveniently.

paperback.definitionKo: 책을 널리 보급하기 위해 싼 가격에 작은 크기로 만드는 책의 판.
paperback.englishDescription: A small sized book for wide distribution sold cheaply.

participation.definitionKo: 모임이나 단체, 경기, 행사 등의 자리에 가서 함께함.
participation.englishDescription: An act of taking part in a meeting, organization, game, event, etc.

participation.definitionKo: 여러 사람이 같이 하는 어떤 일에 끼어들어 함께 일함.
participation.englishDescription: An act of joining a group to work together.

The act of participating in something.

participation.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 모임 등에 같이 참가함.
participation.englishDescription: The act of participating together in an event or meeting.

password.definitionKo: 은행 계좌나 컴퓨터 등에서 보안을 위하여 남이 알 수 없도록 만들어 쓰는 번호.
password.englishDescription: A series of numbers or phrases unknown to others that a person creates to secure his/her bank account, computer, etc.

password.definitionKo: 군대에서, 적군과 구별하여 아군끼리 서로를 확인할 수 있도록 정한 신호.
password.englishDescription: A sign agreed among soldiers in an army in order to distinguish themselves from an enemy and prove the identify each other.

password.definitionKo: 컴퓨터 시스템이나 홈페이지 등에서 사용자를 확인하기 위해 입력하는 문자열.
password.englishDescription: A string of characters that are entered into a computer system, homepage, etc., in order to prove the identity of the user.

pasty.englishDescription: Looking pale or lifeless, and as white as a sheet.

peek.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of slightly tilting one's head or body both ways in order to look at or look for something.

peek.englishDescription: To tilt one's head or body this way and that way to see or find something.

peek.englishDescription: In the manner of slightly tilting one's head or body in order to look at or look for something.

peek.englishDescription: To tilt one's head or body this way and that way to see or find something.

pilgrim.definitionKo: 종교가 처음 일어난 곳이나 성인의 무덤 등 종교적으로 의미가 있는 곳을 찾아다니며 참배하는 사람.
pilgrim.englishDescription: A person who visits places of religious significance such as the place where a religion was founded, a saint's grave, etc., and pays respects.

pincers.definitionKo: 물건을 집는 데 쓰며 끝이 두 가닥으로 갈라진 도구.

pit.definitionKo: 광물을 파기 위해 땅속으로 파 들어간 굴.

pit.definitionKo: 갱 안에서 광석을 나르거나 사람이 드나들도록 만들어 놓은 길.
pit.englishDescription: A path in a pit to transport mined minerals and for people to come and go.

pit.definitionKo: 몹시 험하고 깊게 움푹 파인 땅.
pit.englishDescription: A deep hole hollowed extremely roughly.
An area sunken by drilling or digging.

pit.definitionKo: 땅을 깊고 길게 파서 굴과 같이 만든 큰 구덩이.
pit.englishDescription: A long, deep hole made like a tunnel by digging in the ground.

pit.definitionKo: 흙과 물이 뒤섞여 질퍽거리는 깊은 웅덩이.
pit.englishDescription: A deep hole that is muddy due to a mixture of soil and water.
(figurative) A bad situation difficult to get out.

pit.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 매우 어렵고 절망적이어서 빠져나오기 힘든 상황이나 감정.
pit.englishDescription: (figurative) A very difficult and desperate situation or emotion that one finds hard to escape.

pit.definitionKo: 땅바닥이 움푹 패어 빠지기 쉬운 구덩이.

reward.definitionKo: 무엇을 모집하거나 구하는 일, 또는 사람을 찾는 일 등에 내건 돈.
reward.englishDescription: Money offered in return for recruiting or finding something, or looking for a person.

reward.definitionKo: 도움을 받았을 때 돈이나 선물을 후하게 하여 고마운 마음을 나타냄. 또는 그 돈이나 선물.
reward.englishDescription: An act of expressing thankfulness to another for his/her help through a big gift of cash or goods; or the money or gift.

reward.definitionKo: 도움을 받았을 때 돈이나 선물을 후하게 하여 고마운 마음을 나타내다.
reward.englishDescription: To express thankfulness to another for his/her help through a big gift of cash or goods.

reward.definitionKo: 고마운 일에 대해 보답을 함. 또는 그 보답.
reward.englishDescription: The act of rewarding someone for doing something for which one is grateful, or such a reward.

reward.definitionKo: 일이나 노력의 대가로 받는 돈이나 물건.
reward.englishDescription: Money or things that a person gets in return for his/her work or effort.

robustly.englishDescription: In a state of one's mind and body being strong without any problems.
In a state in which an object or body is solid and sturdy.

robustly.definitionKo: 무르거나 느슨하지 않고 아주 단단하고 굳세게.
robustly.englishDescription: In a solid and strong manner that is not soft or loose.

rock.definitionKo: 서로 손을 내밀어 그 손 모양으로 순위나 승부 등을 정하는 방법.
rock.englishDescription: A method of determining rankings or winners by holding out one's hands to each other and using the shape of the hands.

rock.definitionKo: 바다나 강에서 물속에 잠겨 겉으로 보이지 않는 험한 바위.
rock.englishDescription: An invisible, rough rock submerged in the sea or in a river.

rock.definitionKo: 굉장히 큰 소리나 충격이 물체나 공간을 울리게 하다.
rock.englishDescription: To make an extremely loud sound or shock echo through an object or across a space.

rock.definitionKo: 물체가 자꾸 이쪽저쪽으로 기울어지며 움직이다. 또는 그렇게 하다.
rock.englishDescription: For an object to consistently move, leaning to this way and that way; to make something such a way.

rock.definitionKo: 가위바위보에서, 주먹을 쥐어 내미는 동작. 또는 그런 손.
rock.englishDescription: In a rock-paper-scissors game, the act of clenching one's fist and holding it out, or such a hand.

rock.definitionKo: 지구 겉쪽의 단단한 부분을 이루는 큰 바위.
rock.englishDescription: A large rock which makes up the hard surface of the earth.
To shake something to move it; for something to shake and move.

rock.definitionKo: 물체가 자꾸 이쪽저쪽으로 기울어지며 움직이다. 또는 그렇게 하다.
rock.englishDescription: For an object to consistently move, leaning to this way and that way; to make something such a way.

rock.definitionKo: 물체가 이쪽저쪽으로 자꾸 기울어지며 움직이다. 또는 그렇게 하다.
rock.englishDescription: For an object to consistently move, leaning to this way and that way; to make something such a way.

rock.definitionKo: 이리저리 자꾸 흔들리다. 또는 그렇게 되게 하다.
rock.englishDescription: To swing back and forth repeatedly; or to make this happen.

rock.definitionKo: 이리저리 자꾸 흔들리다. 또는 그렇게 되게 하다.
rock.englishDescription: To swing back and forth repeatedly; or to make this happen.

rock.definitionKo: 자꾸 이리저리 흔들리다. 또는 그렇게 되게 하다.
rock.englishDescription: To swing back and forth repeatedly; or to make this happen.

rock.definitionKo: 굉장히 큰 소리나 충격으로 물체나 공간이 울리다.
rock.englishDescription: For an extremely loud sound or shock to echo through an object or across a space.

samguksagi.definitionKo: 고려 시대에 김부식이 왕의 명령을 받고 펴낸 역사책. 신라, 백제, 고구려의 삼국 역사에 관해 쓰여 있다. ‘삼국유사’와 함께 한국에 남아 있는 가장 오래된 역사책이다.
samguksagi.englishDescription: a history book written by Kim Busik in the Goryeo Dynasty under the king's order; a book about the history of the Three Kingdoms: Silla, Baekje and Goguryeo; the oldest extant Korean history book along with the Samgungnyusa.

satirize.definitionKo: 문학 작품 등에서, 현실의 바람직하지 못한 점이나 이치에 맞지 않는 일 등을 빗대어 비웃으면서 씀.
satirize.englishDescription: In a literary or other work, an act of satirizing and making fun of an undesirable aspect of reality or an unjustifiable incident, etc., by writing about it with comparison to others.

satirize.definitionKo: 남의 부족한 점을 다른 것에 빗대어 비웃으면서 폭로하고 공격하다.
satirize.englishDescription: To make fun of, disclose, and attack someone's weakness by comparing it to another thing.

satirize.definitionKo: 문학 작품 등에서, 현실의 바람직하지 못한 점이나 이치에 맞지 않는 일 등을 빗대어 비웃으면서 쓰다.
satirize.englishDescription: In a literary or other work, to satirize and make fun of an undesirable aspect of reality or an unjustifiable incident, etc., by writing about it with comparison to others.

scatteringly.definitionKo: 부스러기 같은 것이 어지럽게 흩어지는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
scatteringly.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the motion of crumbs or similar stuff being scattered.

scatteringly.definitionKo: 작게 깨어져 여러 조각으로 여기저기 흩어져서.
scatteringly.englishDescription: In the state of being broken into small pieces and scattered here and there.
In the state of being separated from each other.

scatteringly.definitionKo: 부스러기 같은 것이 어지럽게 흩어지는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
scatteringly.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the motion of crumbs or similar stuff being scattered.

scribbly.definitionKo: 글씨나 그림 등을 자꾸 아무렇게나 쓰거나 그리는 모양.
scribbly.englishDescription: In the manner of repeatedly and carelessly writing or drawing something.

second-hand.englishDescription: Being so old as to become in a poor condition and wornout.

secrecy.definitionKo: 떳떳하게 드러내지 않고 은밀하게 감추는 것.
secrecy.englishDescription: An act of hiding something secretly, not revealing it openly.

selection.definitionKo: 여러 사람 가운데서 쓸 사람을 뽑음.
selection.englishDescription: The choice of a particular person among many people.
The act of picking out among many.

selection.definitionKo: 일정한 기준을 따라 가려서 따로 나눔.
selection.englishDescription: The act of sorting according to set standards.

selection.definitionKo: 여럿 중에서 필요한 것을 골라 뽑음.
selection.englishDescription: The act of choosing what one needs among many.

selection.definitionKo: 여럿 가운데에서 목적에 맞는 것을 골라 정함.
selection.englishDescription: The act of choosing one appropriate thing among many.

selection.definitionKo: 여러 가지 중에서 골라서 다루거나 뽑아 씀.
selection.englishDescription: An act of choosing among many.

selection.definitionKo: 여럿 가운데서 쓸 만한 것은 쓰고 버릴 것은 버림.
selection.englishDescription: Among many, an act of taking what is worth taking, and dumping what is not.

self-proclamation.englishDescription: The act of naming oneself as something.

seobangnim.definitionKo: 남편의 결혼한 남동생을 이르거나 부르는 말.
seobangnim.englishDescription: brother-in-law: A word used to refer to or address a married younger brother of one's husband.

seobangnim.definitionKo: 남편의 여동생의 남편을 이르거나 부르는 말.
seobangnim.englishDescription: brother-in-law: A word used to refer to or address the husband of one's husband's sister.

shirt.definitionKo: 칼라가 달려 있으며 앞 부분의 단추를 채워 입는 셔츠.
shirt.englishDescription: A shirt with collars worn by fastening the buttons on the front.

shirt.definitionKo: 양복 안에 받쳐 입거나 겉옷으로 입는 서양식 윗옷.
shirt.englishDescription: A western upper garment worn inside a suit or as an outer clothing.

shore.definitionKo: 바다나 강, 호수의 물과 닿아 있는 땅의 부분.
shore.englishDescription: The land adjoining an ocean, river or lake.

shore.definitionKo: 바다, 강, 호수 등과 닿아 있는 땅.
shore.englishDescription: Land bordered by the sea, rivers, lakes, etc.

shore.definitionKo: 땅과 닿아 있는 바다, 강, 호수 등의 물가.
shore.englishDescription: The edge of the sea, rivers, lakes, etc., bordered by land.

shower.definitionKo: 비처럼 물을 뿜어내는 기구로 몸을 씻음.
shower.englishDescription: The act of washing the body with a nozzle that sprays water like rain.

shower.definitionKo: 비처럼 물을 뿜어내는 기구로 몸을 씻다.
shower.englishDescription: To wash the body with a nozzle that sprays water like rain.

shower.definitionKo: 갑자기 세게 내리다가 곧 그치는 비.
shower.englishDescription: Rain that pours down violently and suddenly, and then lets up soon.
(figurative) A continuous, sudden outpouring of something.

shrinkage.englishDescription: The state in which something contracts or gets smaller in volume as it dries or wilts.

sickle.definitionKo: 농작물이나 풀을 베는 데 쓰는 농기구.
sickle.englishDescription: A farm implement used to cut crops or mow grass.

sieve.definitionKo: 체나 거름종이 등으로 찌꺼기나 건더기가 있는 액체에서 순수한 물만 받아 내다.
sieve.englishDescription: To use a sieve or filter paper to extract water only from dregs or other residual stuff in a liquid.

sieve.definitionKo: 찌꺼기나 건더기가 있는 액체에서 물만 빼고 찌꺼기를 걸러 내는 그물.
sieve.englishDescription: An object which filters out dregs or other residual stuff in a liquid.

sieve.definitionKo: 가루 등을 체로 흔들어서 곱게 만들다.
sieve.englishDescription: To pour flour, etc., on a sieve and shake it, making the powder finer.

sieve.definitionKo: 가루를 곱게 만들거나 액체에서 찌꺼기를 거르는 데 쓰는 도구.
sieve.englishDescription: A tool for filtering powder or liquid finely by separating lumps or remnants.

silliness.englishDescription: The quality of being silly and acting slowly.

simultaneously.definitionKo: 여러 가지 일을 한 번에 하려고.
simultaneously.englishDescription: With the purpose of doing several things at a time.
At the same time, or at the almost same time.

simultaneously.englishExpression: all together; simultaneously; in a body

sincerely.englishDescription: With all one's heart, great care, etc.
In the manner of being not contrary to a fact or reason.
In a diligent and truthful manner.
A word describing one thinking or acting sincerely, kindly and affectionately.
Sincerely and genuinely in one's attitude or behavior.
In a sincere manner without falsehood.

sincerely.definitionKo: 사실과 조금도 다르지 않게 말 그대로.
sincerely.englishDescription: In the manner of being not contrary to a fact.

sincerity.englishDescription: A sincere, genuine attitude or behavior.
The quality or state of being sincere and genuine.
The state of being trustworthy and faithful.
The state of being loyal, honest, and sincere.

skillfully.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 여러 번 해서 서투르지 않고 익숙하게.
skillfully.englishExpression: skillfully; in an experienced manner; expertly
skillfully.englishDescription: In the manner of doing something expertly, not poorly because one has often experienced it.

slum.englishDescription: A neighborhood populated by poor people.

smog.definitionKo: 공장이나 자동차 등에서 내뿜는 연기나 배기가스가 안개처럼 떠 있는 현상.
smog.englishDescription: A phenomenon in which the smoke or exhaust from a factory, vehicle, etc., floats in the air like fog.

sole.definitionKo: 서거나 걸을 때 바닥에 닿는 발 아래쪽의 평평한 부분.
sole.englishDescription: The flat underside of the foot that touches the ground when one is standing or walking.

sole.definitionKo: 신발의 바닥에 붙이는 가죽이나 고무 조각.
sole.englishDescription: A piece of leather or rubber attached to the soles of shoes.

somalia.definitionKo: 아프리카 동북부에 있는 나라. 주요 산업으로는 축산, 농업 등이 있다. 공용어는 소말리어와 아라비아어이고 수도는 모가디슈이다.
somalia.englishDescription: A country located in northeastern Africa; its major industries are livestock, agriculture, etc.; its official languages are Somali and Arabic, and its capital is Mogadishu.

sponge.definitionKo: 생고무나 합성수지로 만든, 작은 구멍이 많이 뚫려 있으며 부드럽고 탄력이 좋아 수분을 잘 빨아들이는 물건.
sponge.englishDescription: A soft, elastic object made of crude rubber or synthetic resin that has many small holes and soaks up moisture well.

squalidly.englishDescription: In a very dirty and messy state.

squalidly.definitionKo: 상태가 깨끗하지 못하거나 행동이 바르지 못한 모양.
squalidly.englishDescription: In a dirty state or in a wrong manner in behaving.

stereotype.englishDescription: Being stereotyped or using such methods.

stereotype.definitionKo: 이미 굳어져서 쉽게 바뀌지 않는 생각.
stereotype.englishDescription: An idea that has become fixed and does not change easily.

stereotype.definitionKo: 어떤 대상에 대하여 겪어 보지 않고 미리 짐작하여 가지는 생각.
stereotype.englishDescription: A preconceived idea that one has before actually knowing an object.

stereotype.definitionKo: 어떤 대상에 대하여 겪어 보지 않고 미리 짐작하여 가지는 생각.
stereotype.englishDescription: A preconceived idea that one has before actually knowing an object.

string.definitionKo: 물건을 매거나 꿰거나 하는 데 쓰는 가늘고 긴 물건.
string.englishDescription: A thin, long object, used to tie or run through things.

string.definitionKo: 물건을 꿰는 끈이나 꼬챙이. 또는 거기에 무엇을 꿴 것.
string.englishDescription: A string or stick for threading things; things threaded on a string or stick.

string.definitionKo: 끈이나 꼬챙이 등에 꿰어 놓은 물건을 세는 단위.
string.englishDescription: A unit for counting things threaded on a string or stick.

string.definitionKo: 구멍을 통해 실이나 끈 등을 한쪽에서 다른 쪽으로 나가게 하다.
string.englishDescription: To make a string, thread, etc., go from one side to another through a hole.

string.definitionKo: 무엇을 묶거나 매는 데 쓰는 가늘고 긴 물건.
string.englishDescription: A thin, long item that is used to tie or knot things together.

string.definitionKo: 기타나 거문고 등의 악기에서, 소리를 내는 데 사용하는 가늘고 긴 팽팽한 끈.
string.englishDescription: A thin, long, tight cord that is used for musical instruments such as a guitar or geomungo, a traditional Korean musical instrument, to produce sound.

string.definitionKo: 식물의 속 한가운데에 있는 단단한 부분.
string.englishDescription: The hard part in the center of the inside of a plant.

su.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 할 만한 능력이나 어떤 일이 일어날 가능성.
su.englishDescription: A bound noun meaning the ability to do something or the possibility that a certain event occurs.

su.definitionKo: 바둑이나 장기에서 서로 한 번씩 번갈아 두는 횟수를 세는 단위.
su.englishDescription: When playing go or janggi, the Korean version of chess, a bound noun that serves as a unit for counting the frequency of taking turns moving alternately.
A bound noun that serves as a unit for counting the number of poems or songs.

su.definitionKo: 짐승이나 물고기, 벌레 등을 세는 단위.
su.englishDescription: A bound noun that serves as a unit for counting the number of animals, fish, bugs, etc.

subdivisions.englishDescription: A detailed list of items or provisions.

sublimation.definitionKo: 고체가 액체가 되는 일 없이 곧바로 기체로 변함. 또는 기체가 곧바로 고체로 변함.
sublimation.englishDescription: The process of changing from a solid to a gas without passing through a liquid phase; the direct change from a gas to a solid.

subside.definitionKo: 궂은 날씨가 풀리거나 강하게 나타나던 자연 현상이 약해지다.
subside.englishDescription: For a bad weather to become warmer or for a strong natural phenomenon to become weaker.
For the symptoms of a disease to get better.

subside.definitionKo: 궂은 날씨가 풀리거나 자연 현상이 약해지다.
subside.englishDescription: For a bad weather to become warmer or for a strong natural phenomenon to become weaker.
For the symptom of a disease to get better.

subside.englishDescription: For a liquid to seep into something or dry out gradually.

subside.definitionKo: 고여 있던 액체가 점점 말라 없어져 가다.
subside.englishDescription: For a static liquid to dry out gradually.

subside.englishDescription: For a static liquid to dry out gradually.

sullenly.definitionKo: 마음에 들지 않아 입이나 눈을 한쪽으로 살짝 일그러뜨리는 모양.
sullenly.englishDescription: A word describing one's eyes or lips being drawn to one side slightly because one does not approve of something.
In the manner of expressing one's dissatisfaction.

sullenly.definitionKo: 마음에 들지 않아 입이나 눈을 자꾸 한쪽으로 살짝 일그러뜨리는 모양.
sullenly.englishDescription: A word describing one's eyes or lips being drawn to one side slightly because one does not approve something.

sweetback.definitionKo: 기생이나 창녀에게 빌붙어 영업을 도와주며 남편처럼 지내는 사내.
sweetback.englishDescription: A man who sponges off a gisaeng, a female entertainer, or prostitute, helping her acquire business yet acting as a husband.

task.definitionKo: 국가나 민족 등이 반드시 해야 할 일이나 임무.
task.englishDescription: A mission or duty that must be fulfilled by a nation or people.

task.definitionKo: 개인이나 단체가 맡아서 해야 할 일이나 업무.
task.englishDescription: A work or business to be assumed and done by an individual or a group.

task.definitionKo: 회사나 학교 등에서 맡겨진 일이나 풀어야 할 문제.
task.englishDescription: A duty assigned or a problem to be solved in a company or at school.

task.definitionKo: 주로 사회적으로 처리하거나 해결해야 할 문제.
task.englishDescription: A problem that needs to be managed or resolved by the society.
The work assigned in a workplace, etc.

task.definitionKo: 깊이 생각해 보거나 해결해야 할 문제.
task.englishDescription: A problem that needs to be contemplated or solved.
A piece of work that one should do.

theologist.englishDescription: A person who studies the truth of religions.

thorn.definitionKo: 살에 박힌 나무의 가늘고 뾰족한 부분.
thorn.englishDescription: The thin, pointed end, usually of the stem of a plant such as a rose, that is stuck in one's skin.

thorn.definitionKo: 식물의 줄기나 잎, 열매의 겉면에 바늘처럼 가늘고 뾰족하게 돋아난 것.
thorn.englishDescription: A thin, pointed, needle-like part protruding from the stem, leaf, fruit, etc.,of a plant.

tipsily.englishDescription: In a manner of one's mind being a bit foggy because one is drunk.

trace.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 사람이 남긴 흔적이나 실마리.
trace.englishDescription: A trace or clue left by something or someone.

trace.definitionKo: 물체가 움직이면서 남긴 자국.
trace.englishDescription: The track left behind by an object as it moves.

trace.definitionKo: 어떤 것이 남긴 표시나 흔적.
trace.englishDescription: A mark or trace that something has left.

trace.definitionKo: 뚜렷하지 않은 기억이나 생각을 짐작하여 되살리다.
trace.englishDescription: To recall one's unclear memory or thought through presumption.

trace.definitionKo: 잘 알지 못하는 것을 짐작하여 찾다.
trace.englishDescription: To find something unknown by conjecture.

trace.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 한 뒤에 남은 흔적.
trace.englishDescription: The mark left after one finishes a certain thing.

trace.definitionKo: 발로 밟고 지나갈 때 남는 흔적. 또는 그때 나는 소리.
trace.englishDescription: A trace left by stepping on something, or a sound made in such a situation.

trace.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 과거에 지나온 과정.
trace.englishDescription: (figurative) One's past journey in life.

trace.definitionKo: 사람의 자취나 흔적.
trace.englishDescription: The trace or track showing that someone was there.

trace.definitionKo: 어떤 곳에 드러난 자취나 흔적.
trace.englishDescription: One's trace or mark left in a certain place.

trace.definitionKo: 어떤 일의 흔적이나 결과.
trace.englishDescription: The trace or result of something

trace.definitionKo: 없어지거나 떠난 뒤에 남는 흔적이나 모습.
trace.englishDescription: A trace or mark that remains after something is gone or leaves.

trace.definitionKo: 희미하게 남은 그림자나 모습.
trace.englishDescription: The faintly remaining shadow or image of something.

trace.definitionKo: 일이나 사람의 자취를 따라가며 찾다.
trace.englishDescription: To follow and find the trace of an incident or a person.

trace.definitionKo: 어떤 태도나 기색.
trace.englishDescription: A certain attitude or hint.

trace.definitionKo: '어떤 태도나 기색'의 뜻을 나타내는 말.
trace.englishDescription: A word indicating “a certain attitude or hint”.

trace.definitionKo: 어떤 행위를 한 뒤에 남긴 표시나 흔적.
trace.englishDescription: A mark or trace that one has left after having done a certain act.

trace.definitionKo: 사물이나 현상이 없어지거나 지나간 뒤에 남겨진 것.
trace.englishDescription: A mark or trace left after an object or phenomenon disappears or passes by.

trace.definitionKo: 다른 것이 닿거나 묻어서 생긴 자리. 또는 어떤 것 때문에 원래의 상태가 달라진 흔적.
trace.englishDescription: A mark that forms when something touches or gets stuck on somethine else, or a trace of change from the original state that is caused by something.

trace.definitionKo: 어떤 사건이나 일에서 증거가 될 만한 기미.
trace.englishDescription: An indication that could be used as the evidence of an incident or thing.

traps.definitionKo: 배나 비행기를 타고 내릴 때 쓰는 사다리.
traps.englishDescription: A ladder used to ascend to or descend from an airplane or ship.

tsunami.definitionKo: 지진이나 화산 폭발 등으로 인해 생기는 큰 해일.
tsunami.englishDescription: A large tsunami caused by an earthquake or volcanic eruption.

tsunami.definitionKo: 갑자기 바닷물이 크게 일어서 육지로 넘쳐 들어오는 것. 또는 그런 현상.
tsunami.englishDescription: A sudden surge of high tide rushing onto the land; or such a phenomenon.

ttawi.definitionKo: 앞에 나온 대상을 낮추거나 부정적으로 이르는 말.
ttawi.englishDescription: A bound noun used to add a debasing or negative meaning to something that was just referred to.

tufty.definitionKo: 풀이나 머리카락 등이 다듬지 않아서 단정하지 못하고 거칠다.
tufty.englishDescription: Grass, hair, etc. that has not been trimmed and is rough and messy.

tufty.definitionKo: 풀이나 머리카락 등이 다듬지 않아서 단정하지 못하고 거칠다.
tufty.englishDescription: Grass, hair, etc., being untidy and rough, as it has not been trimmed.

underclass.definitionKo: 지위, 계급, 수준 등이 낮은 부류.
underclass.englishDescription: A class that holds a lower place in status, rank, level, etc.

unshakably.englishDescription: With firm determination and without being shaken.
In the manner of one's attitude or situation, etc., being clear and unchanging.

unshakably.definitionKo: 어떤 어려운 일이 있어도 흔들리지 않고 그대로.
unshakably.englishDescription: In an unshakable and firm manner even if there is an adversity.

uplift.definitionKo: 땅이 기준이 되는 면에 비해 높아짐. 또는 그런 지반.
uplift.englishDescription: The state of the ground becoming higher than the base level, or such ground.

urgent.definitionKo: 곧 큰 일이 벌어질 듯이 상황이 매우 급하다.
urgent.englishDescription: Imminent as if something is going to happen soon.
Very hurried just before an incident.
Something needing to be dealt with immediately.

urgent.definitionKo: 마감이 바싹 다가와서 시간이 별로 없다.
urgent.englishDescription: Not having much time left, as the due date approaches quickly.

urgent.definitionKo: 사정이나 형편이 빨리 처리해야 할 상태에 있다.
마음이 몹시 급하여 어찌할 바를 모르고 허둥지둥하는 면이 있다.
urgent.englishDescription: Being extremely hurried, being flustered without knowing what to do.
Being urgent as if there were a fire nearby.

urgent.definitionKo: 이리저리 헤매며 어쩔 줄 모르게 급하다.
urgent.englishDescription: Being in a hurry, being flustered without knowing what to do.

usanguk.definitionKo: 삼국 시대에 지금의 울릉도에 있던 나라. 512년에 신라에 합쳐졌다.
usanguk.englishDescription: A state during the Three Kingdoms period in Korea, used to be located in today's Ulleungdo Island and annexed into the Silla Kingdom in 512.

usurpation.definitionKo: 왕위나 나라, 권력 등을 억지로 빼앗음.
usurpation.englishDescription: An act of forcefully taking away a throne, nation, power, etc.

verse.definitionKo: 둘 이상의 가사가 붙어 있는 한 노래에서 이를 나눈 각각의 부분.
verse.englishDescription: One of two or more subsections into which the lyrics of a song is divided.

verse.definitionKo: 시와 같이 일정한 규칙이나 리듬에 따라 지은 글.
verse.englishDescription: A writing created according to a certain rule or rhythms, such as poetry.

verse.definitionKo: 말, 글, 노래 등을 일정하게 나눈 부분.
verse.englishDescription: Parts of a speech, writing, song, etc., that are equally divided.

verse.definitionKo: 말, 글, 노래 등을 일정하게 나눈 부분.
verse.englishDescription: Egments of a speech, writing, song, etc. that are equally spaced.

vice-president.definitionKo: 대학에서, 총장을 돕고 총장이 없을 때에는 총장을 대신하는 총장에 다음가는 직위. 또는 그 직위에 있는 사람.
vice-president.englishDescription: A position just below president at a university, which assists the president and substitutes for him/her when the office is vacant; a person in such a position.

vice-president.definitionKo: 총재를 돕고 총재가 없을 때에는 총재를 대신하는, 총재에 다음가는 직위. 또는 그 직위에 있는 사람.
vice-president.englishDescription: A position just below president in an institution, which assists the president and substitutes for him/her when the office is vacant; a person in such a position.

victor.definitionKo: 싸움이나 경기 등에서 이긴 사람. 또는 그런 단체.
victor.englishDescription: The person who wins a fight, game, etc., or such a group.

vigorously.englishDescription: With a strong and indomitable spirit of overcoming difficulties.
With a strong power or energy.

vigorously.definitionKo: 말이나 행동이 기분이 좋을 정도로 막힘이 없는 모양.
vigorously.englishDescription: In a manner that one's speech and actions are pleasantly fluent.

vigorously.definitionKo: 종이나 천 등을 세게 찢는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
vigorously.englishDescription: A word used to describe the sound made when one tears a piece of paper, cloth, etc., violently, or such a motion.

vigorously.definitionKo: 종이나 천 등을 세게 찢는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
vigorously.englishDescription: A word used to describe the sound made when one tears a piece of paper, cloth, etc., violently, or such a motion.
In the manner of being lively and cheerful.
In the manner of being full of life and energy.
In the manner of doing a certain task vigorously or making a certain event occur frequently.

vigorously.definitionKo: 조금 힘차게 한 번에 뛰거나 뛰어넘는 모양.
vigorously.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of running or jumping across something at once a little powerfully.
A word describing the motion of a fire burning strongly, wildly.

vigorously.definitionKo: 부채나 손 등을 천천히 시원스럽게 흔드는 모양.
vigorously.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of waving a hand or fan slowly, vigorously.
A word describing the motion of washing oneself cleanly, vigorously.

vigorously.definitionKo: 불길이 세고 매우 시원스럽게 타오르는 모양.
vigorously.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of a fire burning strongly, wildly.

vigorously.definitionKo: 부채 등으로 천천히 매우 시원스럽게 부치는 모양.
vigorously.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of waving a hand or fan slowly, vigorously.

vigorously.definitionKo: 가벼운 것을 천천히 시원스럽게 뿌리는 모양.
vigorously.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of repeatedly sprinkling a light object slowly, energetically.
A word describing the motion of running or jumping across something powerfully.

visor.definitionKo: 햇볕을 가리기 위해 모자의 끝에 댄 부분.
visor.englishDescription: A piece added to the front of a cap to block sunlight.

volcano.definitionKo: 땅속에 있는 가스나 용암이 땅을 뚫고 터져 나오는 현상. 또는 그로 인해 생긴 산.
volcano.englishDescription: A phenomenon in which gas or lava underground bursts out through the ground. Or a mountain formed as a result.

wealthy.definitionKo: 살림이 아주 넉넉할 만큼 재물이 많다.
wealthy.englishDescription: Having enough wealth to be well off.
Having enough or a lot of property.
One's property being substantial and sufficient.

woodpecker.definitionKo: 단단한 부리로 나무에 구멍을 내어 그 속의 벌레를 잡아먹는 새.
woodpecker.englishDescription: A bird that makes a hole in a tree with its hard beak and eats bugs in the tree.

woodwork.definitionKo: 나무로 가구 등의 물건을 만드는 일.
woodwork.englishDescription: The act of  making things out of wood, such as funiture.

yelp.definitionKo: 개가 무섭거나 아파서 자꾸 소리를 지르다.
yelp.englishDescription: For a dog to make yelping sounds out of fear or pain.

yelp.definitionKo: 강아지 등이 놀라거나 아파서 자꾸 짖다.
yelp.englishDescription: For a puppy, etc., to cry out due to fear or pain.

yelp.definitionKo: 강아지 등이 놀라거나 아파서 자꾸 짖다.
yelp.englishDescription: For a puppy, etc., to cry out due to fear or pain.

yelp.definitionKo: 개가 무섭거나 아파서 자꾸 소리를 지르다.
yelp.englishDescription: For a dog to make yelping sounds out of fear or pain.

yelp.definitionKo: 개가 무섭거나 아파서 자꾸 소리를 지르다.
yelp.englishDescription: For a dog to make yelping sounds out of fear or pain.

yelp.definitionKo: 강아지 등이 놀라거나 아파서 자꾸 짖다.
yelp.englishDescription: For a puppy, etc., to cry out due to fear or pain.

yeomhada.definitionKo: 죽은 사람의 몸을 씻긴 다음에 수의로 갈아입히고 베로 싸다.
yeomhada.englishDescription: To wash the body of the deceased, then dress it in shroud and wrap it in cloth.
